info.name: Lago API documentation Add_ons Subscriptions API

params.name: external_customer_id
params.description: The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application)

params.name: plan_code
params.description: The unique code representing the plan to be attached to the customer. This code must correspond to the code property of one of the active plans.

params.name: status[]
params.description: If the field is not defined, Lago will return only `active` subscriptions. However, if you wish to fetch subscriptions by different status you can define them in a status[] query param. Available filter values: `pending`, `canceled`, `terminated`, `active`.

items.docs: This endpoint retrieves all active subscriptions.

info.name: Lago Assign a plan to a customer

items.docs: This endpoint assigns a plan to a customer, creating or modifying a subscription. Ideal for initial subscriptions or plan changes (upgrades/downgrades).

params.name: external_id
params.description: External ID of the existing subscription

items.docs: This endpoint retrieves a specific subscription.

params.name: status
params.description: If the field is not defined, Lago will terminate only `active` subscriptions. However, if you wish to cancel a `pending` subscription, please ensure that you include `status=pending` in your request.

items.docs: This endpoint allows you to terminate a subscription.
